findings.title: TestLogger drops logs made through FromContext
findings.body: FromContext returns a fresh TestLogger with independent log counters instead of a contextual view of the receiver. LoggerMiddleware now always logs through `m.logger.FromContext(ctx)`, so when callers/tests provide a TestLogger, the completed-request entry is written to an unreachable temporary logger and is not observable on the logger they supplied. Return the receiver or a derived fake sharing the same backing log storage (and ideally retaining contextual fields).
